parameters.name: AclAction
parameters.description: The action that Cloud Firewall performs on the traffic in the access control policy. Valid values:

parameters.name: AclUuid
parameters.description: The unique ID of the access control policy. You must specify at least one of AclUuid and Direction. If AclUuid is specified, you can query the policy by its ID.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page displayed in a paging query.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the access control policy. Fuzzy queries are supported.

parameters.name: Destination
parameters.description: The destination address in the access control policy. Fuzzy queries are supported. The value varies depending on the DestinationType (destination type).

parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description: The traffic direction controlled by the access control policy. Valid values: in (inbound) or out (outbound). You must specify at least one of Direction and AclUuid. If AclUuid is not specified, you must specify a non-empty Direction. Otherwise, the ErrorParametersDirection error is returned.

parameters.name: IpVersion
parameters.description: The supported IP address version. Valid values:

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language type for receiving messages. Valid values:

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page displayed in a paging query.

parameters.name: Proto
parameters.description: The protocol type of the traffic in the access control policy. Valid values:

parameters.name: Release
parameters.description: The enabled status of the access control policy. Valid values:

parameters.name: RepeatType
parameters.description: The recurrence type of the policy validity period for the access control policy. Valid values:

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: The source address in the access control policy. Fuzzy queries are supported. The value varies depending on the SourceType (source type).
